'''Ma Dawei''' ({{zh|s=马大为}}; born September 11, 1963) is a Chinese chemist and research professor at the Shanghai institute of Organic Chemistry, [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS).<ref>{{cite news|url=https://new.qq.com/omn/20191122/20191122A07LV400.html |script-title=zh:不仅要有所为，还要有所大为 独家专访中科院新院士马大为 |work=qq.com |date=22 November 2019 |accessdate=25 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://tech.sina.com.cn/d/i/2018-11-12/doc-ihnstwwr1255901.shtml |script-title=zh:马大为：对有机化学的探索永无止境 |work=sina |date=12 November 2018 |accessdate=25 November 2018 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Early life and education==
Ma was born on September 11, 1963, into a teacher's family in [[Sheqi County]], [[Henan]].<ref name="goes">{{cite news|author1=Yang Mingyin ({{lang|zh|杨明银}})|url=http://henan.163.com/nanyang/19/1123/10/EULMR9V6043992U5.html |script-title=zh:喜讯！南阳社旗人马大为当选中国科学院院士! |work=163.com |date=23 November 2019 |accessdate=25 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>
In September 1980 he entered [[Shandong University]], where he graduated in July 1984 with a Bachelor of Science degree.<ref name="cat">{{cite news|author1=Gao Yang ({{lang|zh|郜阳}})|url=https://new.qq.com/rain/a/20191122A04QJC |script-title=zh:中科院上海有机所马大为：“他的成就是要改写教科书的” |work=qq.com |date=22 November 2019 |accessdate=25 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>
In September 1984 he studied under Lu Xiyan at the Shanghai institute of Organic Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS), earning a Doctor of Science degree in July 1989.<ref name="cat"/>
From May 1990 he conducted postdoctoral research at the [[University of Pittsburgh]] and [[Mayo Clinic]] in the United States.<ref name="cat"/>

==Career==
He returned to China in 1994 and joined the Shanghai institute of Organic Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS). In January 1995 he was promoted to research follow. In 1997 became an adjunct professor at [[Fudan University]].

==Honours and awards==
* 1997 Distinguished Young Scholar by the National Science Fund<ref name="cat"/> 
* 1998 Outstanding Young Scholars Award of the Qiushi Science and Technology Foundation<ref name="goes"/>
* 2007 State Natural Science Award (Second Class)<ref name="cat"/><ref name="goes"/>   
* 2016 N. C. Yang Lecturer Award<ref name="goes"/>
* August 2017, Arthur C. Cope Scholar Award of the [[American Chemical Society]] (ACS)<ref>{{cite news|author1=Huang Xin ({{lang|zh|黄辛}})|url=http://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2017/8/385878.shtm |script-title=zh:马大为获美国化学会Arthur C. Cope Scholar Award |work=Sciencenet.cn |date=22 August 2017 |accessdate=25 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>
* September 2018, Materials Science Award of the Future Science Awards<ref>{{cite news|url=https://tech.sina.com.cn/d/i/2018-11-18/doc-ihnyuqhh6967926.shtml |script-title=zh:马大为：做科研失败是常事 获奖才是小插曲 |work=Sina |date=28 November 2018 |accessdate=25 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>
* November 2019, Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)
